note: Simple Menu Icons adds an 'icon_upload' managed_file field to the menu_link_content edit form; the chosen icon is stored on the menu link's own link options under menu_icon (fid, uri). It generates a CSS file (public://simple_menu_icons_css/menu_icons_<suffix>.css) that paints each icon as a background-image on menu-icon-<mlid> classes added by hook_preprocess_menu; the CSS suffix lives in State key simple_menu_icons_css_suffix. There is NO config entity, settings page (configure=null), permission, plugin, Drush command, or config schema. All medium/hard cases are grounded in the real persistent state: the per-menu-link options.menu_icon on menu_link_content entities (created in the 'main' menu, namespaced with 'SMI ' titles).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the Simple Menu Icons module, how do I give a menu link an icon, and where does that icon association get stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page. Edit a custom menu link (menu_link_content) and use the added 'Icon image' managed-file field (icon_upload). The uploaded file is stored on the menu link's own link options under menu_icon (fid + uri).

evals.prompt: What image file types can I upload for a menu icon with the Simple Menu Icons module in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: The icon_upload field allows gif, png, jpg, jpeg and svg files (upload location public://menu_icons/).

evals.prompt: How does Simple Menu Icons actually make the icon appear next to a Drupal menu item — does it add an tag?
evals.expected_output: It adds no markup. hook_preprocess_menu adds menu-icon and menu-icon- classes to each item, and the module generates a CSS file that sets the icon as a background-image on those classes (with left padding = icon width). hook_css_alter injects that generated file.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the 'main' menu contains a couple of custom menu links. Exactly one of them has a Simple Menu Icons icon configured. Inspect the live menu links and tell me the title of the one that has an icon.
evals.expected_output: The link titled 'SMI Known Icon Link' has an icon: its menu_link_content link options contain menu_icon (uri public://menu_icons/smi_known.svg). 'SMI Plain Link' has no menu_icon.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a custom menu link titled 'SMI URI Link' in the main menu with a Simple Menu Icons icon configured. Inspect the live menu link and tell me the file URI of its configured icon.
evals.expected_output: public://menu_icons/smi_dashboard.svg — stored at the menu link's link options menu_icon.uri.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the 'main' menu has a custom menu link titled 'SMI Task Link' with no icon. Using the way Simple Menu Icons stores icons, configure an icon on that menu link so it has a menu_icon set in its link options. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The 'SMI Task Link' menu_link_content entity's link options get a menu_icon entry with a non-empty uri (and/or fid), e.g. options['menu_icon']['uri'] = 'public://menu_icons/whatever.svg', then the link is saved.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the 'main' menu has a custom menu link titled 'SMI Target Link'. Set its Simple Menu Icons icon so the icon file URI is exactly public://menu_icons/smi_target.svg, storing it the way the module expects. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The 'SMI Target Link' menu_link_content link options menu_icon.uri is set to public://menu_icons/smi_target.svg and the link is saved.
